meta.title: 第35讲 · 不定式② 自学
meta.subtitle: 自学一遍再上课：热身回顾34讲 → 定语两种逻辑关系 → 状语目的·原因·结果 → 被动式 to be done → 疑问词+to do → 省 to 三家店 → 综合验收（共 9 关 · 53 题。作业卷留到课后当考试，这里不剧透）

nodes.title: ① 热身：34 讲的底子 + 本讲地图
nodes.explain:
第 34 讲我们把不定式的「老四样」过完了：作主语（常用 it 顶着，真正的主语放句末）、作表语、作宾语、作宾补——感官动词（see / watch / notice / hear）和使役动词（make / let / have）后面的不定式不带 to，一变被动 to 还要还原。本讲是下半场，五件新装备：

新装备一句话记住
① 作定语放在被修饰词后面，两种逻辑关系定生死
② 作状语目的 · 原因 · 结果，三套识别暗号
③ 被动式to be done，逻辑主语是动作的承受者
④ 疑问词 + to dowho / what / which / when / where / how + to do，相当于名词
⑤ to 的省略感官使役 / 三大短语 / 前有 do 后省 to

自学方法：先读讲解 → 盖住答案做题 → 点「先想再看答案」核对 → 全懂了点「我学完了」进下一关。
nodes.qs_label: 热身自测：34 讲的底子还在吗（先想再点开）

general_qs.stem: The teacher made us ________ (copy) the new words three times.
general_qs.explain: make 是使役动词，宾补里的不定式不带 to → made us copy。34 讲老规则：see / watch / notice / hear / make / let / have 后接光杆原形。

general_qs.stem: 同一件事变成被动语态：We were made ________ all night.
general_qs.explain: 变被动语态后，原来省掉的 to 要还原 → were made to work。A 死于忘了「被动还 to」这条回收条款。

general_qs.stem: ________ is important to learn English well.
general_qs.explain: 不定式作主语太长时请 it 顶着形式主语的位子，真正的主语 to learn English well 退到句末——34 讲的 it 形式主语。

general_qs.stem: 不定式的否定形式怎么构成？
general_qs.explain: not 放在整个不定式前面：not to do。Tell him not to be late. 就是这么来的。

nodes.title: ② 不定式作定语：两种逻辑关系定生死
nodes.explain:
不定式作定语时，放在被修饰词的后面（后置定语）。它和被修饰词是哪种逻辑关系，决定了句子的意思和写法：

逻辑关系规则例句
主谓关系被修饰词是不定式动词的「执行者」Joe was the first to arrive.（Joe 到 → Joe 是 arrive 的主语）；He was the first to make a voyage around the world. 他是第一个环游世界的人
动宾关系被修饰词是动词的「承受者」；不及物动词后面要补上适当的介词I will have a class to attend.（attend a class）；I have nothing to worry about.（worry 不及物 → worry about nothing）

高频句型顺手收走：the first / the second / the last / the next / the only + 名词 + to do——「第一个 / 最后一个 / 唯一……做某事的人」。

记法：主谓关系「人做事」，直接 to do；动宾关系「物被做」，动词若不及物就得拖个介词出门——nothing to worry about、a pen to write with。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习 1（上）：不定式作定语

general_qs.stem: I'm hungry. Get me something _________.
general_qs.explain: something 和 eat 是动宾关系（eat something）→ 不定式 to eat 后置作定语。A 死于不定式丢了 to；C 死于 eating 表不了「拿来吃的」这层意思；D 死于 for eating 不是本考点格式——考试答案锁定 to do。

general_qs.stem: I was the second ________ in my English paper in the exam.
general_qs.explain: the second + to do：序数词（the first / the second / the last…）后接不定式作定语——「第二个交英语卷的人」。B、C 死于没用不定式；D 死于 to 后面手滑接了 handing。

general_qs.stem: Joe was the first ________ (arrive) at the station, so he got the best seat.
general_qs.explain: the first + to do：Joe 和 arrive 是主谓关系（Joe 到站）→ to arrive。

general_qs.stem: I have nothing ________ about.
general_qs.explain: 动宾关系：worry about nothing（没什么可担心的）。worry 是不及物动词，介词 about 留在句尾。A 死于丢了不定式；C、D 分词方向不对。

general_qs.stem: I need a pen ________.
general_qs.explain: 动宾关系：write with a pen（用钢笔写）。write 在这里是不及物用法，介词 with 得跟着不定式一起留下。A 死于丢了 with——write 什么？钢笔不能被「写」；B 死于丢了 to。

general_qs.stem: 不定式作定语、被修饰词和不定式动词是动宾关系时，若该动词是不及物动词，必须注意什么？
options: 在不定式后保留适当的介词
general_qs.answer: B. 在不定式后保留适当的介词
general_qs.explain: 不及物动词接不了宾语，就要靠介词把关系接上：nothing to worry about / a chair to sit on / a pen to write with。讲义原话：如果是不及物动词，要在不定式后加上适当的介词。

memory.front: 不定式作定语的两种逻辑关系？序数词后面接什么？
memory.back:
后置：不定式放被修饰词后面
主谓关系（人做事）：Joe was the first to arrive.
动宾关系（物被做）：I have a class to attend.（attend a class）
不及物动词 → 介词别丢：nothing to worry about / a pen to write with
高频句型：the first / second / last / next / only + 名词 + to do

nodes.title: ③ 不定式作状语：目的 · 原因 · 结果
nodes.explain:
不定式作状语，一肩挑三职——目的、原因、结果，考试各有一套识别暗号：

用法识别暗号例句
目的状语「为了……」，句首句末都行；= in order / so as + to do(In order) To arrive there on time, I got up one hour earlier than usual. / I stopped to have a rest.
原因状语跟在 glad / sorry / excited / disappointed 等情绪词后面I am sorry to hear that your father is ill. / She was disappointed to find out that the concert had been cancelled.
结果状语only to（不料）/ enough to（足够……能）/ too…to（太……而不能）I visited him only to find him out. / He is old enough to go to school. / He is too young to go to school.

等价互换要看熟：He is too young to go to school. = He is not old enough to go to school.——「太小了不能去」翻个面就是「不够大去不了」，too…to 和 not…enough to 是一句话的两件外套。

记法：目的「为了」、原因「情绪」、结果「三件套」；too…to 天生带否定，enough to 天生带肯定。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习 1（下）：不定式作状语

general_qs.stem: The community（社区）worker is patient enough ________ to the old how to use the phone.
general_qs.explain: enough to do 结果状语：足够耐心「去解释」。enough 后面锁死 to do——A 死于原形裸奔；B 死于三单；D 死于 -ing。

general_qs.stem: ________ myself, I will take up a hobby like painting this summer.
general_qs.explain: 句首表目的，用不定式 To improve（= In order to improve）：「为了提升自己」。A 死于原形不能作状语；B 死于动名词放句首不表目的；D 死于过去分词表被动，方向反了。

general_qs.stem: 同义转换：He is too young to go to school. = He is ________ ________ ________ to go to school.（用 old，3 词）
general_qs.explain: too…to = not…enough to：太年轻去不了 = 不够大去不了。too 后的形容词 young 换成反义词 old，前面加 not，后面配 enough——not old enough。

general_qs.stem: I visited him only ________ him out.
general_qs.explain: only to do 表出乎意料的结果：去拜访他，「不料」他出去了。A 死于 -ing 不表意外结果。

general_qs.stem: I am sorry ________ that your father is ill.
general_qs.explain: 情绪词 sorry 后面接 to do 作原因状语：因为「听到」你父亲病了而难过。

general_qs.stem: She was disappointed ________ (find) out that the concert had been cancelled.
general_qs.explain: disappointed 是情绪词，后面接 to do 交代失望的原因 → to find out。音乐会取消了，她失望地发现这个消息。

general_qs.stem: 作目的状语的不定式短语可以放在句子的什么位置？
general_qs.answer: C. 句首或句末都可以
general_qs.explain: 讲义原话：作目的状语可以放在句首或者句末——To arrive there on time, I got up early. / I got up early to arrive there on time. 两头都行。

memory.front: 不定式作状语的三个用途？too…to 等于哪句话？
memory.back:
目的：为了……，句首句末都行，= in order to / so as to do
原因：glad / sorry / excited / disappointed 等情绪词后接 to do
结果三件套：only to 不料 / enough to 足够 / too…to 太…而不能
too…to = not…enough to：He is too young to go. = He is not old enough to go.

nodes.title: ④ 不定式的被动语态：to be done
nodes.explain:
不定式也有被动语态：to be + 过去分词（to be done）。用它就一个理由——不定式的逻辑主语是动作的承受者：

例句为什么用被动
The room is to be cleaned tomorrow.房间是「被打扫」的
The broken window is to be repaired by a professional.窗户是「被修」的
It is an honour to be invited to the banquet.「我」是被邀请的——承蒙邀请，甚是荣幸
She begged to be allowed to return home.恳求「被允许」回家

记法：一句话判断——主语「去做」用 to do，主语「被做」用 to be done。看到 by 短语、beg / honour 这类句型，先问一句：这个动作落到谁头上？落到主语头上，就是被动。
nodes.qs_label: 练习：不定式的被动语态

general_qs.stem: 不定式被动语态的基本形式是？
general_qs.explain: to be + 过去分词：to be cleaned / to be repaired / to be invited。核心就一条：逻辑主语是动作的承受者。

general_qs.stem: It is an honour ________ ________ (invite) to the banquet.
general_qs.explain: 承蒙「被邀请」赴宴，甚是荣幸——被邀请的人才是荣幸的主人 → to be invited。写成 to invite 就成了「我去邀请别人」，方向反了。

general_qs.stem: She begged ________ ________ ________ (allow) to return home.
general_qs.explain: 她恳求「被允许」回家——allow 这个动作落到她头上 → to be allowed to return home。

general_qs.stem: The broken window is ________ by a professional.
general_qs.explain: 窗户自己不会修，只能「被修」→ to be repaired；后面 by a professional 更是把被动方向写得明明白白。A 死于主动 to repair。

general_qs.stem: The room is to be cleaned tomorrow. 为什么用 to be cleaned？
options: 因为 room 自己会打扫
因为 room 是「被打扫」的对象
表示房间已经打扫完了
general_qs.answer: B. 因为 room 是「被打扫」的对象
general_qs.explain: 不定式被动语态的判断标准只有一条：逻辑主语是动作的承受者。房间是打扫的对象，所以 to be cleaned——房间明天将被打扫。

nodes.title: ⑤ 疑问词 + to do：不定式戴上疑问词的帽子
nodes.explain:
不定式常和疑问词连用，构成疑问词 + to do 短语。这种结构相当于名词，在句中充当主语、宾语、表语等成分：

成分例句
作主语How to solve the problem is very important. 如何解决这个问题很重要
作宾语He didn't know what to say. 他不知道该说什么
作表语The question is where to find the water. 问题是该去哪里找水

能戴的帽子就这几顶：who / whom / what / which / when / where / how（注意名单里没有 why——想问「为什么不做」，下一关的 Why not do 才是正主）。

易混点：what 泛指「什么」，which 特指范围里的「哪一个」。货架上椅子已经摆出来了，纠结的是「哪一把」，就用 which。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习：疑问词 + to do

general_qs.stem: There are so many kinds of chairs on sale that I can't make up my mind ________ to buy.
general_qs.explain: 椅子的大范围已经摆在那儿（so many kinds of chairs），纠结的是「哪一把」→ which 特指范围中的哪一个。A 的 what 泛指「什么东西」，这里范围明确；C、D 与 buy 的意思接不上——buy 还缺宾语，疑问词得能当它的宾语。

general_qs.stem: She doesn't know when ________ (start) working.
general_qs.explain: 「什么时候开始」→ 疑问词 when + to start，整个短语作 know 的宾语。know 后面不能直接接 when + 动词原形，中间必须站着 to。

general_qs.stem: ________ to solve the problem is very important.
general_qs.explain: 「如何解决这个问题」——how 指方式方法，整个短语作主语，谓语用三单 is。

general_qs.stem: The question is ________ to find the water.
general_qs.explain: 「问题是该去哪里找水」——where 指地点，短语作表语。讲义原句 The question is where to find the water.

general_qs.stem: 下面哪个疑问词不能和 to do 连用？
general_qs.explain: 讲义给出的名单是 who / whom / what / which / when / where / how——唯独没有 why。想问「为什么不做」，要用 Why not do（下一关的主角之一）。

memory.front: 疑问词 + to do 相当于什么、能作哪些成分？what 和 which 差在哪？
memory.back:
相当于名词：作主语（How to solve the problem is very important.）、宾语（He didn't know what to say.）、表语（The question is where to find the water.）
可用疑问词：who / whom / what / which / when / where / how（没有 why）
what 泛指「什么」，which 特指范围中的「哪一个」

nodes.title: ⑥ 省 to 第一家：感官动词 · 使役动词
nodes.explain:
第一组省 to 的：感官动词和使役动词。它们后面接宾语 + 不带 to 的不定式作宾补：

家族成员例句
感官动词see / watch / notice / hear 等I saw her enter the room. 我看见她进入了房间
使役动词make / let / have 等He made me laugh. 他让我笑了

⚠️ 34 讲的回收条款要焊死：变被动语态后，省掉的 to 要还原——She was heard to sing. 主动省 to，被动还 to。

记法：「看见听闻、让使派」后头光杆上场；句子一翻成被动，to 立刻归队。
nodes.qs_label: 练习：感官 · 使役动词后省 to

general_qs.stem: I saw her ________ (enter) the room just now.
general_qs.explain: see 是感官动词，宾补用不带 to 的不定式 → saw her enter。

general_qs.stem: He made me ________ (laugh).
general_qs.explain: make 是使役动词 → make me laugh，不加 to。

general_qs.stem: The boss made them ________ twelve hours a day.
general_qs.explain: make sb do sth：使役动词后的宾补是光杆原形 → made them work。B 死于多带了个 to。

general_qs.stem: She was heard ________ (sing) in the next room.
general_qs.explain: 变被动语态后 to 要还原 → was heard to sing。主动是 heard her sing，被动就是 she was heard to sing。

general_qs.stem: 感官动词 / 使役动词后的不定式，什么情况下要把 to 补回来？
options: 主语是第三人称单数时
general_qs.answer: A. 句子变被动语态时
general_qs.explain: 只有一条触发条件：变被动。He was made to work. / She was heard to sing.——时态、人称怎么变都不用管 to 的事。

nodes.title: ⑦ 省 to 第二家：had better / would rather / Why not
nodes.explain:
第二组：三个「天生不认 to」的固定短语，后面直接跟动词原形：

短语意思例句
had better (do)最好……；否定 had better not doYou had better finish your homework before you go out to play. / You had better not stay up late every night, it's bad for your health.
would rather (do)宁愿……；would rather not do；would rather do than doShe would rather walk to work than take the bus. / I would rather not talk about it right now.
Why not (do)…?为什么不……呢？（提建议）= Why don't you do…?Why not go for a walk after dinner? / Why not call me if you need any help?

记法：三家都接光杆原形；否定词 not 一律插在原形前面（had better not tell / would rather not talk）。would rather do than do 是成对的——than 前后两个动词都光杆，一个都不许带 to。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习 2（上）：三大短语省 to

general_qs.stem: You had better ________ (not tell) him the truth.
general_qs.explain: had better 的否定：not 放在动词原形前 → had better not tell（最好不要告诉他真相）。别写成 don't tell 或 not to tell。

general_qs.stem: I would rather ________ (walk) than ________ (take) the bus.
general_qs.explain: would rather do than do：than 前后成对，都用光杆原形 → would rather walk than take。宁愿走路去上班，也不愿坐公交。

general_qs.stem: It's bad for your health. You had better ________ stay up late every night.
general_qs.explain: had better not do——否定词 not 直接放在原形前。B、C、D 都是把 not 的位置或形式搞错了。

general_qs.stem: Why not ________ for a walk after dinner?
general_qs.explain: Why not + 动词原形：Why not go for a walk? 晚饭后为什么不去散散步呢？

general_qs.stem: She would rather walk to work than ________ the bus.
general_qs.explain: would rather do than do 成对出现，than 后面也是光杆原形 → take。D 死于三单——would rather 后没有三单这回事。

general_qs.stem: I would rather ________ ________ (not talk) about it right now.
general_qs.explain: would rather not do：宁愿不谈 → would rather not talk about it。

general_qs.stem: Why don't you call me if you need any help? = Why ________ me if you need any help?
general_qs.explain: Why don't you do…? = Why not do…?——两句是提建议的双胞胎 → Why not call me?

memory.front: had better / would rather / Why not 后面接什么？否定放哪儿？
memory.back:
had better do / had better not do 最好（不）……
would rather do (than do) 宁愿……而不……；would rather not do
Why not do…? = Why don't you do…? 提建议
共同点：都接动词原形；not 插在原形前面

nodes.title: ⑧ 省 to 第三家：前有 do，后省 to
nodes.explain:
第三组最有意思：but / except（除了……之外）前后的 to 去留，只看一件事——but / except 前面有没有实义动词 do 的任何形式：

情况口诀例句
前面有 do（do / does / did / can do…）前有 do，后省 toWe have nothing to do but wait. / They did nothing all day but watch TV.
前面没有 do无 do，to 留下She has no choice but to accept the offer. / He can't speak but to nod his head.

⚠️ 一个要背死的组合：have no choice but to do（别无选择，只能……）——choice 不是 do，to 必须留下；而且这个搭配里的 but 不能换成 except。

记法：「do 到，to 逃」——but 前面只要出现 do 的任何身影（to do / did / can do 都算），but 后面就接光杆原形；找不到 do，to 就老老实实站着。做题先别看 but 后面，先扫一眼 but 前面有没有 do。
nodes.qs_label: 课堂练习 2（下）：前有 do 后省 to

general_qs.stem: They have nothing to do but ________ (stay) at home.
general_qs.explain: but 前面有 to do → 前有 do，后省 to → stay。他们除了待在家里无事可做。

general_qs.stem: There is nothing we can do but ________ (accept) the fact.
general_qs.explain: 别被 there is 句型带偏——往 but 前面扫一眼：can do 也是 do 的形式 → 后面省 to → accept。

general_qs.stem: She doesn't have any choice but ________ (leave) the company.
general_qs.explain: but 前面找不到 do（choice 不是 do）→ to 留下 → to leave。固定搭配 have no choice but to do：别无选择，只能……

general_qs.stem: We have nothing to do but ________ (wait).
general_qs.explain: 前有 to do → 后省 to → wait。我们除了等待无事可做。

general_qs.stem: He can't speak but ________ his head.
general_qs.explain: can't speak 里没有 do → 无 do，to 留下 → but to nod。他不能讲话，只能点头。A 死于看见 but 就条件反射省 to——省 to 的前提是前面有 do。

general_qs.stem: She has no choice but ________ the offer.
general_qs.explain: have no choice but to do 固定搭配：别无选择，只能接受。记住这个搭配里 to 不省、but 不能换成 except。

general_qs.stem: 「前有 do，后省 to」里的 do 指的是？
options: do 的任何形式（do / does / did / to do / can do…）
general_qs.answer: B. do 的任何形式（do / does / did / to do / can do…）
general_qs.explain: 讲义原话：but / except 之前有实义动词 do 的「任何形式」都算——nothing to do、did nothing、can do，全都能触发省 to。

memory.front: but / except 前后 to 的去留看什么？哪个组合必须留 to？
memory.back:
口诀：前有 do，后省 to；无 do，to 留下
有 do：nothing to do but wait / did nothing but watch TV / can do but accept
无 do：can't speak but to nod his head
死记：have no choice but to do（别无选择只能……，but 不能换 except）

nodes.title: ⑨ 综合验收：八关考点一锅端
nodes.explain:
最后一关，不讲新东西——把前面八关的考点混在一起再过一遍。做错哪题，就回哪一关翻口诀卡。

验收清单：定语两关系（主谓 / 动宾 + 介词）· 状语三用途（目的 / 原因 / too…to 与 enough to）· 被动式 to be done · 疑问词 + to do · 省 to 三家（感官使役 / better·rather·Why not / 前有 do 后省 to）。
nodes.qs_label: 综合验收（错哪题回哪关）

general_qs.stem: The old man lives alone and has no one ________.
general_qs.explain: 回②定语关：动宾关系 talk to no one——talk 不及物，介词 to 得跟着不定式一起留下。A 死于丢介词；B 死于丢 to。

general_qs.stem: He was ________ excited ________ say a word.
general_qs.explain: 回③状语关：too…to 太……而不能——他兴奋得一句话也说不出来。C 的 very 不能和 to 搭结构；D 死于 enough 得放在形容词后面（excited enough to）。

general_qs.stem: It is a great honour ________ ________ (choose) as monitor.
general_qs.explain: 回④被动关：「我」是被选上的 → to be chosen。写成 to choose 就成了「我去选别人」，方向反了。

general_qs.stem: Nobody told me ________ the machine.
general_qs.explain: 回⑤疑问词关：「怎样启动」→ 疑问词 how + to start，整个短语作 told 的宾语。语序永远是疑问词在前、to do 在后。

general_qs.stem: The teacher had the boy ________ the classroom after school.
general_qs.explain: 回⑥感官使役关：have 是使役动词 → have sb do → had the boy clean。B 死于多带的 to——主动句宾补不带 to。

general_qs.stem: It's raining hard. You had better ________ ________ (not leave) now.
general_qs.explain: 回⑦短语关：had better not do → not leave。否定词 not 插在原形前面。

general_qs.stem: The child did nothing all day but ________.
general_qs.explain: 回⑧前有 do 关：did nothing——but 前面有 do 的过去式 did → 后省 to → cry。
